claims.wording: Hidden File Cleaner is a Mac app published under the Idol Software name.
claims.excerpt: Hidden File Cleaner is a Mac app that ensures annoying hidden files don't clutter your drives.; © 2026 Idol Software

claims.wording: The advertised requirement is macOS 14+; the download component calls the installer Universal.
claims.conditions: Exact binary version, architectures and successful execution not independently inspected.

claims.wording: The homepage advertises $8.99 per licence as a one-time payment with free updates, and a seven-day trial with no credit card required.
claims.excerpt: $ 8.99 /license One-time payment No monthly fees Free updates; Try it for free for 7 days! No credit card required.
claims.conditions: Dollar symbol only: currency code, tax, regional checkout total, refund terms, trial restrictions and activation not verified. No checkout visited. Do not rewrite as USD or a tested purchase.

claims.wording: The vendor documents metadata cleanup including .DS_Store, .fseventsd, .Spotlight-V100, .Trashes, .apdisk and AppleDouble files, with ZIP support.
claims.excerpt: Hidden File Cleaner removes unnecessary macOS metadata files, including .DS_Store, .fseventsd, .Spotlight-V100, .Trashes, .apdisk, and ._ (AppleDouble) files.; It even works on ZIP archives!
claims.conditions: Do not repeat blanket nonessential/safe claims or infer every dotfile is removable.

claims.wording: The vendor advertises a pre-cleaning preview, a Finder context-menu action, and optional continuous or one-time cleanup of selected locations.
claims.excerpt: Preview exactly what will be removed before cleaning; right clicking and selecting 'Clean with Hidden File Cleaner'; Choose to run continuous cleanup or one-time cleaning.
claims.conditions: No cleanup run. Do not infer per-action approval for continuous mode, Trash semantics or recoverability.

claims.wording: The vendor says it merges AppleDouble metadata into originals and pauses Spotlight indexing for the drive when cleaning .Spotlight-V100.
claims.excerpt: it properly merges the metadata back into the original files, just like the official dot_clean command-line tool; it pauses Spotlight indexing for that drive
claims.conditions: Implementation, restore behavior and device compatibility untested; not a preservation guarantee.

claims.wording: The EULA grants a purchased personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence for use on your own computers for personal or professional purposes and prohibits redistribution, resale, sublicensing, modification and reverse engineering.
claims.excerpt: personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable license ... on your own computers for your own personal or professional purposes. You may not redistribute, resell, sublicense, modify, or reverse engineer the Software.
claims.conditions: No numeric device allowance inferred. EULA also provides software as-is without warranty.

claims.wording: The privacy policy says filesystem data stays local and the app can work offline once activated; it also discloses in-app Google Analytics, Firebase Crashlytics and Lemon Squeezy licence management.
claims.excerpt: All filesystem data remains strictly on your local computer; Within the Hidden File Cleaner app: We use Google Analytics; we use Firebase Crashlytics; Once activated, Hidden File Cleaner can be used completely offline.
claims.conditions: Not a no-telemetry claim. Do not treat filesystem-content handling or provider retention as independently audited.

workflow.title: Before sharing a Mac drive: review metadata, not every hidden file
workflow.primaryIntent: Choose a metadata-specific cleanup workflow for a shared external drive or ZIP without confusing it with reclaiming Mac disk space.
workflow.lead: Proposed conclusion: a targeted metadata cleaner addresses drive-sharing clutter; a broad storage investigation answers a different question. Neither size nor a leading dot grants permission to delete.
sections: Define the receiving-device problem without claiming a reproduced compatibility failure
Vendor-documented file types and AppleDouble/Spotlight handling, with attribution
Select locations and review the preview; distinguish optional continuous mode from a one-off pass
Separate metadata housekeeping from storage capacity and app-growth investigation
Choose a specialist or broader preview with honest privacy, runtime and cost boundaries
workflow.visualPlan: After lead: official competitor app image only once rights cleared. Later: selected Breathing Room Space example-data preview.
workflow.interactionHandoff: Non-mutating decision checklist: receiving-device clutter vs low Mac free space; selected shared location vs whole system; metadata preservation/backup needs; one-time vs continuous mode. Output bounded guidance, never delete files or estimate savings.
workflow.additionalEvidenceBeforeTutorial: If adding executable commands, verify Apple documentation and retain safe reproduction evidence separately; do not copy vendor claims into a tested tutorial.
